Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Backend Engineer, Ledger role at Larkspur Payments. I successfully migrated a monolith to event-driven services with zero downtime, reducing p99 latency from 1.9s to 340ms. I am proficient in Kubernetes, Terraform, and PostgreSQL schema design and query tuning. I look forward to contributing to Larkspur Payments' ledger systems.
